recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. No current core source edit is needed for FHIR-19650; future changes to Device hierarchy guidance should be handled through new OO tracker decisions rather than reopening this already-applied R5 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-19650 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by OO. It reported that the Device narrative was out of date because it still contrasted Device with DeviceComponent and DeviceMetric even though DeviceComponent no longer existed, and requested updating the text to reference the Device parent element for hierarchies.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-19650 was found. The stale narrative text was removed by commit a7f2575daae7bbacd9a22ea439c7ec35a4784f96, which listed FHIR-24936 and rewrote the Device Scope and Usage and Boundaries text to describe Device instances/components and parent relationships instead of the old DeviceComponent split. The matching StructureDefinition summary was later updated by commit 334268c12b164fb910884605255cf3da17132c17 for FHIR-23768.
additional_context: FHIR-23768 raised the same obsolete DeviceComponent wording and was considered applied through the broader FHIR-24936 healthcare-product scope/boundary work. Both related issues are already represented on the combined branch, so this seed audit does not publish duplicate related decisions. Current source/fhir.ini lists Device as active and approved, while DeviceComponent appears only in commented or dropped entries.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Device introduction says a Device can represent a whole device or a component of an encapsulating device and points to the parent device, and the current Device StructureDefinition description says physical units can consist of modules represented by multiple Device resources bound through the parent element. The obsolete DeviceComponent contrast is absent from active Device source.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue raised the same stale DeviceComponent wording and is already represented on the combined branch by e76e836fa54a4529b7a29c721a85572cb49349a5.

Broader Published healthcare-product Scope/Boundary update through which the Device narrative wording was applied; already represented on the combined branch by 3660ffb8c59b7289a2a01dfa5ec99004df4fbeca.
